_README: Declared fixes for products whose dropdowns offer Style x Colour combinations that no
variant backs. Erik's calls, 2026-08-07. Nothing here is inferred.
mode 'recolour'      -> every garment becomes ONE colour; Colour survives as a single
value and the theme renders it as static text, not a dropdown.
mode 'foldIntoStyle' -> each garment keeps its own colour, which a shared dropdown
cannot express, so the colour moves into the Style value and
deleteMediaMatching is a list of FILENAME FRAGMENTS. Deletion is irreversible from
here - the photo would have to be re-uploaded - so it is opt-in per product and the
script refuses to remove the last photo on a product.

5762255585436.title: Historic Puyallup Raceways #33332
5762255585436.why: Erik: offer the tee AND the hoodie in Athletic Heather only; drop Ash and its photo.
_resolved: The Ash hoodie photo WAS deleted here, which left the hoodie falling back to a
lifestyle shot of a tee. Erik then judged the two greys close enough and asked for it
🔑 Deleting product media does NOT delete the file. It stays in Shopify Files, still
READY, at a different CDN url (the /products/ path, no attachment UUID) - the url the
product was serving 404s. Recovery goes through files(query:), not a re-upload.
deleteMediaMatching is now empty so a re-run cannot remove it again.
